source_title: Cincinnati Open 2026 QF: Iga Swiatek On-Court Interview
zh: 每当对手不得不退赛，总是让人非常失望。
这不是你希望看到的那种胜利。
是的，当然。
说实话，看到这种情况我就感到焦虑，所以我希望Elena会没事。
显然，下一站比赛是重中之重。
我知道这一站也很重要，但美网就是美网，我希望她能为此做好准备，因为她也非常接近世界第一了。
这很遗憾，因为我觉得我们打了一场精彩的比赛。
但健康是第一位的，所以我希望她会没事，一切都会好。
我们也是。
我们希望她会没事。
如果Elena在听，我们祝你早日康复。
让我们借此机会和你聊几分钟，谈谈你现在打的网球。
你似乎状态正佳，心情很好，走上球场时带着微笑。
你作为卫冕冠军回到了网球的核心地带。
回到俄亥俄州梅森的感觉有多特别？
是的，我感觉很棒。
我感觉已经准备好打出最佳水平，过去几周给了我很多信心，所以我很高兴能在这里打出我喜欢的网球，而且这很有趣。
好的，我们要到8:30男生们才出来。
那你和我能不能打一会儿单打，帮我提高一下音量？
就是想问一下。
我是开玩笑的啦。
你能帮我们在网球上签个名吗？
在你签名之前，简单说一句，杰西卡·佩古拉，你和她交手过很多次，你很了解她的打法。
她很强硬。
你也很强硬。
当你和杰西交手时，我们将会看到怎样的比赛？
嗯，她是个很棒的竞争者，而且我感觉我们在巡回赛上已经交手过很多次，
我们打过很多场比赛，我们都发挥出了最好的水平，像是火星撞地球，
总是那么艰难。
比赛互有胜负，很多次都打到三盘，所以我很期待这场比赛，因为对我来说
这肯定会是一个挑战。
她在硬地球场上的打法很棒，是的，这肯定会是一场精彩的半决赛。
好的，祝你在半决赛中好运。
欢迎回到辛辛那提，你的卫冕冠军，各位，伊加·斯瓦泰克。
让我们给你一些签名网球。

_asr_rows.text: It's always a huge disappointment when an opponent has to retire from a match.
It's not the kind of win that you want to see.
Yeah, of course.
Honestly, I was feeling anxious just looking at this situation, so I hope Elena will be
fine.
And obviously, the next tournament is the priority.
I know this one is important as well, but US Open is US Open, and I hope she's going
to be ready for that, because she's also super close to being number one in the world.
So it's a shame, because I felt we were playing a good match.
But health is a priority, so I hope she's going to be okay, everything.
We do.
We hope she's going to be okay.
If Elena's listening, we do wish you a speedy recovery.
Let's take this opportunity to spend a couple minutes with you, talk about the kind of
tennis you're playing now.
You seem that you're in a zone, you're in a good place, that smile when you walk
out on court.
You're back here as defending champion to the heart of tennis.
How special to be back here in Mason, Ohio?
Yeah, I feel great.
I feel ready to play my best game, and the last weeks have been giving me a lot of confidence,
so I'm happy to be here playing good tennis, tennis that I like, and I enjoy, and for
sure it's fun.
Okay, so we have not till 8.30 until the guys come out.
So can you and I play singles for a little while, and you can help me with my volume?
Just got to ask.
I mean, I'm kidding.
Will you sign some tennis balls for us?
Before you do, real quick, Jessica Pagula, you've played her a lot, you know her game
very well.
She's tough.
You're tough.
What do we have in store when we watch you play Jessie?
Well, she's a great competitor, and you know, I feel like we've been on tour for,
we've been playing many matches where we had our best games like clashing, and it's
always such a tough match.
It went both ways, many three-sellers, so I'm excited to play this match because for sure
it's going to be a challenge for me.
She has a great game for hard courts, and yeah, it's going to be a good semi for sure.
All right, we wish you best of luck in the semis.
Welcome back to Cincy, your defending champion, everyone, Higa Shiontek.
Let's get some autographed tennis balls for you.
